svg.aria-label: Above, the shared parameters Θ over loss contours; below, the four learners' timelines. Each learner leaves Θ at its own pace toward its own data's minimum and publishes a snapshot when it is due, while it keeps training. At quorum the syncer waits a grace window, weights the snapshots by tokens squared over steps and merges them with RDA, which keeps the mean length the weighted mean loses; the Nesterov step carries momentum past the learners. Each learner aligns with the new Θ between its own steps and keeps what it trained since its snapshot, which its next snapshot carries. Over three rounds the learners agree more and Θ settles in the valley.
